eligibility_order: Retain actual code from the existing direct handle's poll.
Immediately call observe_exit, which samples the shared clock even for None.
A first real exit retains actual code and reap before sampling, and retains its observation when sampling succeeds.
Retain eligibility code and sample in status before deciding whether to signal.
Only for None, require sample strictly less than unchanged reap_end AND unchanged phase end.
A late None sets timed_out and unread_or_dropped_unknown, then raises TimeoutError before any KILL attempt.
The existing handler retains kill_or_reap_error and latches first failure without replacing an earlier cause.
An eligible None keeps the existing single direct KILL and remaining(reap_end)-bounded actual wait.
publication_budget: remaining original phase only; at most final1500000000ns
actual_exit_rule: Only real actual poll/wait return code; None never implies exit or reap.
post_reap_accounting: Unreaped caller forbids every later wrapper file write. Actual reap precedes a fresh bounded root-only count before every later write.
limits: No OS-preemption or scheduling-stall bound is established by a sample and source predicate.
A clock failure cannot establish a timestamp or timely reap; retained null and failure rules apply.
Runtime, signal delivery, timely reap, pipe delivery and durability remain UNVERIFIED.
Parent causal inspection, exclusive temporal ownership and final caller/transport/interface reviews remain external duties.
